chain.text: **Site & Staff** - 62 vehicles; 140 drivers. - Operations lead: Halvard Onstad. - Night shift supervisor: Teodora Blaskovic; night shift not fully staffed. **Certification & Compliance** - Certified June 2023; renewal due June 2028. - Route change: 7 days' notice. - Incident report: within 24 hours. **Operations** - Average 410 daily departures; winter peak 530. - Cancellations: 1.8%. - May 2026: roster published twice, two shifts uncovered; roster needs one named publisher. **Maintenance** - 8 lifts; brake check every 6000 km. - Feb 2025: brake line failure, 9 vehicles grounded 4 days; cause not established. - 1100 spare parts line items; contract renegotiated Nov 2025; supplier contact Ingrid Solheim. - Parts over €500: two quotations. **Fuel & Finance** - Sept 2024: fuel card cloned, €4200 lost; second approval above €200. **Projects & Risks** - Electrification study approved, unfunded; second charging bay Q3. - Old ticketing terminal on 3 routes.
